Description:
One operation picked at random for the whole test; fmt, rm, operands and delays random per request.
Common to all tests (base_test):
- flush on the fly in 50 % of seeds (one pulse after 30k-65k cycles)
- reset on the fly in 30 % of seeds (5-10 resets, first after 1/4-1/2 of the requests)
- inter-request delay: 0 (50 %), 1-10, 11-25, 26-31, 40-100 cycles
- operand class weights: normal 50, subnormal 30, zero/INF/qNaN/sNaN 5 each
- mantissa patterns: all-zeros, all-ones, walking-one, walking-zero, random
- 90 % properly NaN-boxed operands
Pass/Fail Criteria:
0 UVM_ERROR / UVM_FATAL in the test log:
- every response matches the ref model (fpu_sb)
- no cvfpu_sva X-check failure
